architecture.i2v: src/h3_backend/routes/i2v.py: I2VPipe and frozen I2VPipeState, with complete local admission/preparation/upload/build/execution/verification/publication flow
architecture.v2v: src/h3_backend/routes/v2v.py: V2VPipe and frozen V2VPipeState, with complete local continuation flow
architecture.submission: Routes pass the composed pipe to the one dispatcher.submit(pipe), returning HTTP202; public pipe.admit() delegates to that same dispatcher
architecture.execution: The centralized worker invokes the admitted pipe.arun(); each operation executes dependent steps explicitly in sequence, without stage registries, callback lists, a DSL, inheritance or parallel gather of dependencies
architecture.configuration: Fluent methods return self and perform no file/network/inference work. Requests are validated deep snapshots; state inspection returns deep copies of frozen dataclasses. Dispatcher reference is read-only. Config seals during/after admission; incomplete/wrong-mode/missing-anchor configs rejected before run creation; duplicate submission rejected
architecture.state: Each pipeline owns its dataclass request/run/references/workflow; I2V has no unused parent/motion fields; V2V alone holds its parent and required reference flags
architecture.dispatcher: service.py contains only centralized coordination, guards/lifecycle/telemetry/error cleanup, review/read endpoints and thin legacy create/continue_run adapters; no _admit/_prepare/_execute_i2v/v2v business pipelines remain
architecture.shared_tools: The same workflow.py builder/configuration, ComfyClient, media functions, Store and telemetry; no new horizontal framework modules

http_compatibility.preserved: Existing request schemas, GET/long-wait/video/accept/reject/sequence endpoints, chunk storage and legacy manifests. Both aliases construct operation-local fluent objects and use the same dispatcher. Accept never starts another chunk.

safety.global_coordination: One lock and active slot across both pipes, host RAM guard before admission and now throughout preparation/execution, background worker ownership, own-UUID cancellation transport unchanged
safety.execution_ownership: arun requires the active admitted run and asyncio.current_task() == dispatcher._task before effects; direct/concurrent/replay execution and foreign-dispatcher admission rejected
safety.snapshot_review_fix: An inherited dispatcher alias gap was reproduced and fixed: the worker receives a deep Run snapshot separate from the caller's returned Run, so mutations of returned id/seed/prompt/references cannot poison execution or strand the slot
safety.shutdown_review_fix: An inherited admission/shutdown race was reproduced and fixed: after awaited admission, closing is rechecked before reserving the slot or creating the worker; a newly-created run is interrupted and admission rejected, without waiting unboundedly on admission I/O during shutdown
safety.cleanup: Intermediate failures stop downstream work, persist errors, stop telemetry/guard tasks and release the matching slot. Shutdown before worker start and waiter cancellation remain covered
safety.v2v_inputs: Accepted parent required; exact last-frame Picture1, original identity Picture2, recent tail Video1 with optional audio; eight-identity limit and exclusion of previous anchors retained
safety.guards: Path/source/hash/alias/symlink/overwrite checks, literal Markdown, atomic chunk publication and restart without replay preserved

hash_and_generation_contract.provenance: Legacy mode golden workflow_hash, canonical template/config provenance and actual persisted workflow_api.json SHA256 remain distinct and tested
hash_and_generation_contract.unchanged: All seven workflow JSON/manifests preserved byte-exact; no model/sampler/attention/resolution/VAEs/decode/saver/post-processing changes

validation.lint_command: uv run ruff check src tests
validation.frozen_source_check: git diff --exit-code 7ad8846 -- workflows assets prompts src/h3_backend/workflow.py src/h3_backend/comfy.py src/h3_backend/media.py src/h3_backend/store.py src/h3_backend/telemetry.py src/h3_backend/models.py src/h3_backend/api.py passed
validation.frozen_hash_check: 11 before/after SHA256 values match: seven workflow files plus accepted parent/child manifests and chunk.mp4 files
validation.new_regressions: Pure fluency/self returns; per-instance dataclass collections; request/public state/returned Run isolation; post-admission freeze and repeated submit; invalid/incomplete modes/anchor contracts; sequential traces and injected upload/build/execute/probe failures for both modes; worker ownership/replay/foreign-dispatcher controls; RAM during preparation and after submission; shutdown while admission is gated. Existing 116 regressions retained.

note: CPU suite uses existing synthetic FFmpeg fixtures and fake Comfy transport. Scratch/local reports and videos are not part of the commit.
